scope: Actual catalog clothing through UI selection, fitting-guide/source comparison, five actions and both facings, project save/reopen, native PNG and CharacterPack download; then close the workbench context and load each downloaded pack into a fresh independent player. Functional evidence is separate from visual acceptance.
observationMethod: MutationObserver reads canvas frame metadata published with its bitmap. Playback runs at normal 1x speed. Raw observations, missed positions and gaps are reported; no assertion that browser instrumentation sees every engine tick. ZIP/PNG decoding and metadata checks are independent of observation coverage.
loadTimingMethod: Wall time from the browser operation until the ready state. Outfit timings include asset fetch, decoding and all-frame validation; they are separate from warm playback observations. Fresh contexts have no application caches, while HTTP/browser caches may remain warm.

warmObservedCadence.method: Intervals between observed position changes within the selected action, excluding the initial play interval and later action transitions. Includes skipped render positions; not a guarantee that every source frame was displayed.
